notes: The offer that appears once a session at a calm moment (client/scenes/court/offer_popup.gd), cut from art/reference/offers_popup.png (art/slices/offers_popup.json). Rects are the painting's; on a taller canvas the whole popup is moved down by half the extra height, and the game shows dimmed behind it where the painting has its castle.

The banner, the three tiles, the timer plate and the green button are painted empty: the offer's title (Cinzel, ivory on the crimson), up to three of what it holds (each tile: the reward's picture and its words), how long it lasts, and its App Store price are set live. LATER and the close button keep their paint.

Text rects are their lines' own boxes (a line at 40 is 56 tall; two at 21 are 60), centred where the painting centres the plate, so the words sit on the plate's middle (tests/text_sits_where_painted.gd).

Tiles (x 107..331, 358..584, 612..835, y 908..1112): the picture in a 204x120 box at the top, the words (two lines at 21) in the 60 under it. The picture is RewardArt's (client/scripts/ui/reward_art.gd), the same the Royal Delivery draws: large paintings drawn down, never up -- a diamonds line's pack vessel, the store's large potions and charter, a frame round the lord's own face, a name colour's tinted chip, a title's scroll.
